name: What should I consider when planning the layout of my covered outdoor kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when planning the layout of my covered outdoor kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: When planning your covered outdoor kitchen layout, consider the 'work triangle' principle: optimizing the proximity of your cooking, cleaning, and preparation zones. Also, think about traffic flow, dining areas, and storage needs. A key decision factor is your primary use case: will it be for casual family meals, large entertaining, or a specialized cooking hobby? This will influence appliance selection, counter space, and the overall size and configuration of your kitchen, ensuring it meets your specific lifestyle requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan your layout considering the 'work triangle,' traffic flow, and dining areas. Your primary use case is a key decision factor that dictates appliance and space needs.
